```{r}
library(here)
library(tidyverse)
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(ggplot2)
library(MCMCglmm)
library(coda)
```

## Data preparation
### Load file
```{r}
individual_data <- read.csv2(here("original_paper", "IndividualData.csv"))

individual_data
```

### Clean dataset
```{r}
# Clean the dataset by extracting the variables needed for simulation H1b (Node degree), added group_size, max_share, and not_shared in the dataset

clean_data <- individual_data %>%
  select(Condition, Session, Group, Individual, Sex, Age, Animals_shared)

clean_data$Session_ID <- with(
  clean_data,
  interaction(Group, Condition, Session, drop = TRUE)
)

clean_data <- clean_data %>%
  group_by(Group, Condition) %>%
  mutate(
    Group_size = n_distinct(Individual),
    max_share = Group_size - 1,
    not_shared = max_share - Animals_shared
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

clean_data <- as.data.frame(clean_data)
```

## run original GLMM 
### original model
```{r}
clean_data <- clean_data %>%
  mutate(across(c(Condition, Sex, Age, Group, Session_ID), factor))

# prior with residual prior
prior <- list(
  R = list(V = 1, nu = 0.002),          # residual (overdispersion) variance
  G = list(
    G1 = list(V = 1, nu = 0.002),       # Group
    G2 = list(V = 1, nu = 0.002)        # Session_ID
  )
)

set.seed(123)

node_degree_origin <- MCMCglmm(
  Animals_shared ~ Age + Sex * Condition,
  random = ~ Group + Session_ID,
  family = "poisson",
  data = clean_data,
  prior = prior,
  nitt = 230000,
  burnin = 30000,
  thin = 200,
  verbose = TRUE
)

summary(node_degree_origin)
```

### original GLMM + ID as random
```{r}
prior_ID <- list(
  R = list(V = 1, nu = 0.002),
  G = list(
    G1 = list(V = 1, nu = 0.002),
    G2 = list(V = 1, nu = 0.002), 
    G3 = list(V = 1, nu = 0.002)   
  )
)

set.seed(123)

node_degree_origin_ID <- MCMCglmm(
  Animals_shared ~ Age + Sex * Condition,
  random = ~ Group + Session_ID + Individual, # add Individual in the random effects
  family = "poisson",
  data = clean_data,
  prior = prior_ID,
  nitt = 230000,
  burnin = 30000,
  thin = 200,
  verbose = TRUE
)

summary(node_degree_origin_ID)
```

## simulation
```{r}
set.seed(456)

nsim <- 5 ## change to 100 for final run

individual_var <- 0 #no individual random effect in the generating model
base_data <- clean_data
base_data$Individual <- factor(base_data$Individual)


# 1. Generating parameters from the original MCMCglmm
X <- model.matrix(
  ~ Age + Sex * Condition,
  data = base_data
)

# Preserve non-age coefficients
beta <- colMeans(node_degree_origin$Sol)[colnames(X)]

age_terms <- grep("^Age", names(beta), value = TRUE)

stopifnot(
  length(age_terms) > 0,
  nrow(X) == nrow(base_data),
  all(is.finite(beta))
)

# Set all Age coefficients to zero
beta[age_terms] <- 0

# Preserve variance parameters
v <- colMeans(node_degree_origin$VCV)

variance_terms <- c("Group", "Session_ID", "units")

stopifnot(
  all(is.finite(v[variance_terms])),
  all(v[variance_terms] >= 0),
  length(individual_var) == 1,
  is.finite(individual_var),
  individual_var >= 0
)

upper <- base_data$Group_size - 1

stopifnot(
  all(is.finite(upper)),
  all(upper >= 0),
  all(upper == floor(upper)),
  all(base_data$max_share == upper),
  !anyNA(base_data[c("Group", "Session_ID", "Individual")])
)


# 2. Generating simulated data
# Draw one random intercept per unique ID
draw_intercepts <- function(id, variance) {
  id <- as.character(id)
  ids <- unique(id)

  effects <- setNames(
    rnorm(length(ids), mean = 0, sd = sqrt(variance)),
    ids
  )

  unname(effects[id])
}

# Generated Animals_shared (<= group-1)
rtrunc_pois <- function(rate, limit) {
  if (limit == 0 || rate == 0) return(0)

  values <- seq.int(0, limit)

  log_weights <- dpois(
    values,
    lambda = rate,
    log = TRUE
  )

  weights <- exp(log_weights - max(log_weights))

  values[
    sample.int(
      n = length(values),
      size = 1L,
      prob = weights
    )
  ]
}

generate_data <- function() {
  dat <- base_data

  eta <- drop(X %*% beta) +
    draw_intercepts(dat$Group, v["Group"]) +
    draw_intercepts(dat$Session_ID, v["Session_ID"]) +
    draw_intercepts(dat$Individual, individual_var) +
    rnorm(nrow(dat), mean = 0, sd = sqrt(v["units"]))

  lambda <- exp(eta)

  stopifnot(all(is.finite(lambda)))

  dat$Animals_shared <- vapply(
    seq_len(nrow(dat)),
    function(i) rtrunc_pois(lambda[i], upper[i]),
    numeric(1)
  )

  dat$not_shared <- dat$max_share - dat$Animals_shared

  # Verify bounds
  stopifnot(
    all(dat$Animals_shared >= 0),
    all(dat$Animals_shared <= upper),
    all(dat$not_shared >= 0)
  )

  # Verify that other columns remain unchanged
  other_columns <- setdiff(
    names(base_data),
    c("Animals_shared", "not_shared")
  )

  stopifnot(identical(
    dat[other_columns],
    base_data[other_columns]
  ))

  dat
}


# 3. Extracting and summarising Age results
extract_age <- function(fit, iteration, model_name) {
  tab <- summary(fit)$solutions

  lower <- tab[age_terms, "l-95% CI"]
  upper_ci <- tab[age_terms, "u-95% CI"]
  p <- tab[age_terms, "pMCMC"]

  # Diagnostic flag only: low ESS does not itself prove
  # non-convergence, and high ESS does not prove convergence
  min_fixed_ess <- min(coda::effectiveSize(fit$Sol))
  min_variance_ess <- min(coda::effectiveSize(fit$VCV))

  data.frame(
    simulation = iteration,
    model = model_name,
    term = age_terms,
    estimate = unname(tab[age_terms, "post.mean"]),
    lower = unname(lower),
    upper = unname(upper_ci),
    pMCMC = unname(p),
    age_ESS = unname(tab[age_terms, "eff.samp"]),
    significant = unname(
      p < 0.05 & (lower > 0 | upper_ci < 0)
    ),
    covers_zero = unname(
      lower <= 0 & upper_ci >= 0
    ),
    low_ESS = min(min_fixed_ess, min_variance_ess) < 100,
    error = NA_character_
  )
}

# Record errors
failed_result <- function(iteration, model_name, error_message) {
  data.frame(
    simulation = iteration,
    model = model_name,
    term = age_terms,
    estimate = NA_real_,
    lower = NA_real_,
    upper = NA_real_,
    pMCMC = NA_real_,
    age_ESS = NA_real_,
    significant = NA,
    covers_zero = NA,
    low_ESS = NA,
    error = error_message
  )
}

safe_mean <- function(x) {
  if (all(is.na(x))) return(NA_real_)
  mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)
}

summarise_performance <- function(results) {
  results %>%
    group_by(model, term) %>%
    summarise(
      attempted = n(),
      completed = sum(is.na(error)),
      failed = sum(!is.na(error)),
      low_ESS_fits = sum(low_ESS, na.rm = TRUE),

      false_positive_rate = safe_mean(significant),
      coverage_95 = safe_mean(covers_zero),
      bias = safe_mean(estimate),
      RMSE = sqrt(safe_mean(estimate^2)),

      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      failure_rate = failed / attempted,

      # Monte Carlo standard errors across simulated datasets
      FPR_MCSE = sqrt(
        false_positive_rate *
          (1 - false_positive_rate) / completed
      ),

      coverage_MCSE = sqrt(
        coverage_95 *
          (1 - coverage_95) / completed
      )
    )
}


# 4. Generate shared batch of simulated datasets
sim_datasets <- lapply(
  seq_len(nsim),
  function(i) generate_data()
)

# Inspect the first simulated dataset
head(sim_datasets[[1]])


# 5. Fit ORIGINAL MODEL to each simulated dataset
# Random effects: Group + Session_ID

set.seed(789)

original_list <- vector("list", nsim)

for (i in seq_len(nsim)) {

  original_list[[i]] <- tryCatch({

    fit_original <- MCMCglmm(
      Animals_shared ~ Age + Sex * Condition,
      random = ~ Group + Session_ID,
      family = "poisson",
      data = sim_datasets[[i]],
      prior = prior,
      nitt = 230000,
      burnin = 30000,
      thin = 200,
      verbose = FALSE
    )

    extract_age(
      fit = fit_original,
      iteration = i,
      model_name = "Original"
    )

  }, error = function(e) {

    failed_result(
      iteration = i,
      model_name = "Original",
      error_message = conditionMessage(e)
    )

  })

  if (i %% 10 == 0) {
    message("Original model: ", i, " / ", nsim)
  }
}

results_original <- bind_rows(original_list)

# Present ORIGINAL MODEL results
performance_original <- summarise_performance(results_original)

print(performance_original, width = Inf)

# Individual simulation results
head(results_original)

# Failed or low-ESS fits
diagnostics_original <- results_original %>%
  filter(!is.na(error) | low_ESS %in% TRUE)

print(diagnostics_original)


# 6. Fit ORIGINAL MODEL + INDIVIDUAL
# Random effects: Group + Session_ID + Individual

set.seed(101112)

individual_list <- vector("list", nsim)

for (i in seq_len(nsim)) {

  individual_list[[i]] <- tryCatch({

    fit_individual <- MCMCglmm(
      Animals_shared ~ Age + Sex * Condition,
      random = ~ Group + Session_ID + Individual,
      family = "poisson",
      data = sim_datasets[[i]],
      prior = prior_ID,
      nitt = 230000,
      burnin = 30000,
      thin = 200,
      verbose = FALSE
    )

    extract_age(
      fit = fit_individual,
      iteration = i,
      model_name = "Original + Individual"
    )

  }, error = function(e) {

    failed_result(
      iteration = i,
      model_name = "Original + Individual",
      error_message = conditionMessage(e)
    )

  })

  if (i %% 10 == 0) {
    message("Original + Individual: ", i, " / ", nsim)
  }
}

results_individual <- bind_rows(individual_list)


# Present ORIGINAL MODEL + INDIVIDUAL results
performance_individual <- summarise_performance(
  results_individual
)

print(performance_individual, width = Inf)

# Individual simulation results
head(results_individual)

# Failed or low-ESS fits
diagnostics_individual <- results_individual %>%
  filter(!is.na(error) | low_ESS %in% TRUE)

print(diagnostics_individual)
```
